name: Glaucus of Athens
bio: Glaucus of Athens is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors records the poet's date as unknown.
This archive carries the 2 epigrams ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 774, 775).

poems.title: Book IX, 774
poems.author: Glaucus of Athens
poems.text: The Bacchante is of Parian marble, but the sculptor gave life to the stone, and she springs up as if in Bacchic fury. Scopas, thy god-creating art has produced a great marvel, a Thyad, the frenzied slayer of goats.

poems.title: Book IX, 775
poems.author: Glaucus of Athens
poems.text: The Bacchante has made the son of Cronos a Satyr, and he rushes to the frenzied dance as if he were in Bacchic fury.
